title: Validate hosted planning records
responsibility: Define runtime schemas for plans, designs and approvals and reject records that do not match.

inputs.name: hubSchemas.schema
inputs.description: Runtime schema used to parse the value.

outputs.name: hubContractSchema
outputs.description: Contract schema containing responsibility, named/typed input and output arrays, string error/state arrays and supported viewport names.

outputs.name: hubPlanSchema
outputs.description: Plan schema with supported category, identity/path/title/goal, timestamp, base commit, contract and SHA-256.

outputs.name: hubDesignSchema
outputs.description: Design schema with numbered version, generator, prompt/notes, contract, images with positive sizes/dimensions, optional revision anchor and 1 to 10 options. Option objects require nonblank direction/provenance and at least one image.

outputs.name: hubApprovalSchema
outputs.description: Approval schema with UUID, unit/version, image bindings, nullable notes hash, contract hash, timestamp and optional option ID.

outputs.name: hubSchemas
outputs.description: Parsed schema result, including transformations and removal of unknown keys where the chosen schema permits; rejects unsuccessful parsing with artifact-corrupt.
